summary: Blue Owl Capital Inc. reported the completion of a $750 million offering of 6.750% Senior Notes due 2036 by its subsidiary Blue Owl Finance LLC, with guarantees from the company and several subsidiaries. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, and mature on August 18, 2036, with interest payable semi-annually. This is a routine debt financing under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing includes the indenture and supplemental indenture details, along with standard redemption and change-of-control repurchase provisions. No unusual structural or strategic elements are present.
